minutes.headline: Assessors signed the excise commitment and reviewed a draft tax classification slideshow that still had errors to fix
minutes.summary: The board approved the October 14 executive session minutes, signed the excise tax commitment and a forestry plan, and reviewed the state-approved growth data. It went through a draft tax classification presentation for the November 24 hearing, caught a double-counted new growth figure, and flagged a split-rate table that looked wrong. It also discussed website pages and meeting dates, then adjourned without entering executive session.

public_comment.topic: A former board member praised the website revamp and asked that online property maps and record cards be updated promptly when bills go out. Also asked the board to be ready to answer which property groups will see big increases.

votes.motion: Approve the executive session minutes of October 14th.
Move into executive session under purpose 7, not to return to open session.
Adjourn the meeting in its entirety instead of entering executive session.

budget_items.what_was_said: The commitment covers a set of bills with a stated valuation and excise total, signed by the board. Signatures serve as the vote.
New growth from 42 parcels came in near the budget projection. Members said estimates should stay conservative.
The average single family value rose from last year, with smaller increases than the two prior years.
The calculated levy limit and maximum allowable levy were shown, but new growth was added twice and must be corrected.
The split-rate savings table looked wrong and is still being reworked.
The program is planned for a set number of participants and is paid from the overlay.

decisions.decision: No vote needed on the growth forms. Members will sign the LA forms the next day.
The assessor will correct the double-counted new growth and rework the split-rate table before the hearing.
Agreed to ask for separate website pages for the Board of Assessors and the assessing department, with agenda, minutes and YouTube links on the board page.
The presentation will go to the town manager to put in the Select Board packet.
Next meetings set for November 4 and November 18; December 2 set and December 16 tentative.

what_happened.line: The Board of Assessors reviewed a draft tax classification presentation for the November 24 hearing and found new growth had been counted twice.
The split-rate savings table looked wrong and is still being reworked before the hearing.
The board signed the excise tax commitment, and signatures served as the vote.
Members will sign the state growth forms the next day, and the presentation goes to the town manager for the Select Board packet.
The board agreed to ask for separate website pages for the board and the assessing department, and set its next meetings.

why_it_matters: The tax classification hearing decides whether residential and commercial property are taxed at one rate or split rates, which shapes the share of the levy on a household's tax bill.
The draft figures were still being corrected, so the numbers in the Select Board packet are the ones to check before the hearing.
